mechanism: Both drugs inhibit CYP2D6 metabolism; tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and bupropion is a moderate CYP2D6 inhibitor, leading to increased tolterodine plasma concentrations and anticholinergic effects.
action: Monitor for excessive anticholinergic effects (urinary retention, constipation, dry mouth, cognitive effects); consider dose reduction of tolterodine or alternative antimuscarinic agent.
